title: DOW-UAP-D3, Mission Report, Arabian Gulf, 2020
doc_notes: This document is a declassified U.S. Air Force Mission Report (MISREP) detailing a UAP sighting in the Arabian Gulf, heavily redacted under 1.4(a).

incidents.summary: Four UAP observed flying in formation or sequence beneath an aircraft.
incidents.quote: AT APPROX 1736Z 4 UAP WERE OBSERVED BENEATH
